**Yes, but not by Sarah Chen alone.** Acme is eligible for a $1,000,000 limit, and the parent guarantee is what makes it eligible. Under the 2026 Credit Policy, the limit needs **Director of Finance approval (Elena Novak)** and **VP Sales concurrence (Michael Torres)**.

**1. The request.** CR-9203 is for C-1001. It would raise the limit from $250,000 to $1,000,000. Sarah Chen submitted it on 2026-09-23, and it relies on the Acme Group parent guarantee.
- CR-9203 is not in the `credit_requests.csv` extract I have. I used the ERP record you supplied.
- CR-9201 is also pending for the same customer, also from Sarah Chen on 2026-09-23, for $400,000. Finance should withdraw or merge one of the two so the customer doesn't end up with two conflicting limits.

**2. The customer.** ERP C-1001 "Acme Mfg. Holdings" is the same company as CRM-2048 "Acme Manufacturing." They share the same DUNS number (04-812-7730) and the same address (2200 N Industrial Pkwy, Milwaukee). CRM records the account as **Strategic**.
- CRM-2091 / C-1044 "Acme Industrial Supply Co." in Akron is a different company and is not relevant here.

**3. The policy.** Northstar Credit Policy 2026 (CREDIT-POLICY-2026) applies. It is effective 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31.

**4. Payment history.** The policy fails a customer if any invoice due in the 12 months before the request was paid more than 30 days late, or is unpaid more than 30 days after its due date. That window runs from 2025-09-23 to 2026-09-23. Acme passes.

| Invoice | Due date | Paid date | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-60412 | 2025-11-28 | 2025-11-24 | On time |
| INV-62011 | 2026-07-25 | 2026-07-22 | On time |
| INV-62305 ($720,000) | 2026-10-02 | Unpaid | Not yet due on the request date, so outside the test |

INV-62305 was due on 2026-10-02 and is still unpaid. Finance may want to watch it.

**5. The maximum limit.**
- The policy maximum for a Strategic account is $750,000.
- Guarantee GRT-ACME-2026 adds $400,000. It is given by Acme Group Holdings, Inc. and names Acme Mfg. Holdings as the only covered company. It is in force from 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31, which covers the request date.
- The maximum is therefore **$1,150,000**. The requested $1,000,000 is within it.
- Without the guarantee, the request would exceed the $750,000 maximum.

**6. The requestor's authority.** Sarah Chen is an Enterprise Account Executive. That role has no credit approval authority under the policy.

**7. The required approvers.** The new total limit is above $500,000, so the policy requires:
- **Director of Finance approval.** Elena Novak holds this role.
- **VP Sales concurrence**, because Acme is a Strategic account. Michael Torres holds this role.

The separation-of-duties rule bars only the person who submitted the request, Sarah Chen. Neither Novak nor Torres submitted it, so both can act.

{
  "outcome": "APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION",
  "request": {"id": "CR-9203", "customer": "Acme Mfg. Holdings (ERP C-1001) / Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048)", "current_limit": 250000, "requested_limit": 1000000,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "Sarah Chen (sarah.chen@northstar.example)", "basis": "guarantee"},
  "eligibility": {"status": "eligible", "maximum_limit": 1150000,
                  "basis": "Strategic tier maximum $750,000 (CREDIT-POLICY-2026 §5) + $400,000 parent guarantee GRT-ACME-2026 naming Acme Mfg. Holdings, in force 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31; no invoice paid or unpaid >30 days past due in the 12 months before 2026-09-23",
                  "late_invoices": []},
  "authority": {"policy": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026", "requestor_limit": 0, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Director of Finance, with VP Sales concurrence",
                "approvers": [{"name": "Elena Novak", "role": "Director of Finance", "kind": "approval"},
                              {"name": "Michael Torres", "role": "VP Sales", "kind": "concurrence"}]},
  "evidence": ["User-supplied ERP record for CR-9203", "credit_policy_2026.md (CREDIT-POLICY-2026)", "acme_parent_guarantee.md (GRT-ACME-2026)", "crm_accounts.csv (CRM-2048, Strategic)", "customers.csv (C-1001, matching DUNS and address)", "erp_invoices.csv (INV-60412, INV-62011, INV-62305)", "erp_credit.csv (C-1001 limit $250,000)", "employees.csv", "organization_chart.md"],
  "missing_evidence": ["CR-9203 does not appear in the credit_requests.csv extract; CR-9201 ($400,000, same customer, same requestor and date) is also pending and should be reconciled"]
}
```
